={
  "model": "qwen2.5-coder:7b",
  "prompt": "Extract all Action Items from these ADRs. For each action item, output:
- ADR number
- Item ID (e.g. IMP-001)
- Description
- Status: classify as DONE, IN PROGRESS, or TODO based on context
- Priority: HIGH if it blocks go-live (compliance, data integrity), MEDIUM if it improves quality, LOW if nice-to-have

Group by status (TODO first, then IN PROGRESS, then DONE).
End with a summary: X total items, Y done, Z remaining.

ADR Content:
{{ $json.stdout.substring(0, 14000) }}",
  "stream": false,
  "options": { "temperature": 0.2, "num_predict": 800 }
}
